tasks.meaning: true-positive response count for 1-back and 2-back trials
tasks.unresolved: exact denominator/load mapping; do not call normalized accuracy

dictionary_meanings.F: Likely valid, problem occurred which affected performance for a limited number of responses/mild to moderate effect

primary_qc.requirements: all five selected scores finite and each selected task QC code exactly V or F at the same participant/session occasion

vonly_sensitivity_qc.requirements: all five selected scores finite and each selected task QC code exactly V

missingness.rule: no imputation; complete five-task occasions only

occasion_rule.ordering: ascending integer parsed from repository session label ses-N
occasion_rule.continuation_exclusion: exclude occasion-map rows whose approved comparability status or occasion identifier denotes continuation; fresh reconstruction excludes sub-20812/ses-2
occasion_rule.comparability: candidate comparable by session label only
occasion_rule.prohibited_interpretation: do not infer pure measurement error, task-version equivalence, practice effects, or permanent traits

reference_a.definition: all participants with at least one complete synchronized V/F occasion; earliest eligible occasion only

reference_b.definition: primary 52-participant subset; earliest selected complete V/F occasion

primary_vf.definition: first two jointly complete synchronized V/F occasions

vonly_sensitivity.definition: first two jointly complete synchronized V-only occasions

folds.candidate_recommendation: sort Reference-A participant_id strings lexicographically; use numpy 2.5.2 default_rng(42).permuted; assign fold as zero-based permutation index modulo 5
folds.conflict: The literal seeded permutation does not match Recovery Phase 1 expected identity lists. Those lists exactly equal unpermuted sorted round-robin assignment. R2/approval evidence applied the seeded permutation to 52 participants, not 109.
folds.required_decision: approve one exact identity map and its hashes before production

center.primary: arithmetic mean of Y for the task/fold training-reference rows

zero_or_near_zero.proposed_refusal: nonfinite scale or scale <= 1e-12 * max(1, abs(center))
zero_or_near_zero.reason: historical code used inconsistent 0.01 and 1e-6 thresholds; frozen contract specifies only zero-scale refusal

M0.fit: per task and held-out fold on Reference-A training identities only

M1.fit: ordinary least squares with intercept, direction*X = intercept + slope*session_age, per task and held-out fold on Reference-A training identities
M1.sensitivity_residual_scale: sample SD of training residuals, ddof=1
M1.support: inclusive closed interval [minimum finite training age, maximum finite training age] per task/fold
M1.extrapolation: age < minimum or age > maximum; equality is supported
M1.P3: if age missing/outside support, set m1_supported=false and m1_coordinate=null; emit fallback_model=M0 and fallback_coordinate equal to the separately computed M0 value; never label fallback as M1

outputs.wide_requirement: exactly five task coordinate columns plus key/provenance fields
outputs.combined_stratified_view: optional; must preserve analytical_stratum and may repeat a physical source key across strata; must never be called a canonical single cohort
outputs.model_rows: models/scales are columns of interpretation, not additional source observations; any long expansion by model or scale must report its multiplier explicitly
outputs.fallback_rows: P3 fallback is metadata/value on the same source observation, not an additional observation

bootstrap.approved_high_level: participant-level resampling; refit transformation; target 5000 valid from at most 10000 attempts
bootstrap.historical_evidence_limitation: R2 feasibility sampled 52 primary participants and then selected their Reference-A rows; it did not resample the complete 109-person Reference A and did not apply folds

proposed_design_per_analysis_stratum.overlap_preservation: resample analysis-stratum Reference-A identities with replacement and use the same draw multiplicities in both analysis and reference; separately resample Reference-A identities outside that stratum with replacement
proposed_design_per_analysis_stratum.fixed_sample_sizes: 52+57 reference draws for Primary; 45+64 reference draws for V-only; analysis draws 52 or 45 respectively
proposed_design_per_analysis_stratum.duplicate_identity_handling: retain every draw with a unique draw_id; duplicate identities contribute repeated clusters, never silently deduplicate
proposed_design_per_analysis_stratum.fold_handling: retain the approved original identity fold; all duplicate draws of an identity use that fold; exclude every draw of held-out identities from that fold's training reference
proposed_design_per_analysis_stratum.refit: recompute M0/M1 parameters and selected scale inside every replicate
proposed_design_per_analysis_stratum.invalid_replicate: record reason and do not coerce undefined values to zero

validity.proposed_acceptance: >=95% of attempts valid and at least 5000 valid replicates
validity.proposed_review_zone: 80% to <95% valid: refit result not primary; run separately labelled fixed-transform sensitivity and require review

open_approval_items: PF-003 through PF-009 exact center/scale/zero-scale/M1 amendments
PF-013 through PF-015 exact bootstrap design and failure policy
